scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Assistance For Furniture Sector
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit in the furniture sector undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector.
Commercial production must have started between 20 May 2022 and 19 May 2027.
The unit must be located in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
Application must be submitted online within one year from the date of eligibility.
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies up to ₹50 lakh for capital investment, interest, showroom establishment, plus rent, power and training reimbursements for eligible furniture enterprises.
